Use our comprehensive coursework transfer database^{5} to look up courses you've taken and determine how they may apply to UMass Global required courses.

For those who are applying to a UMass Global MyPath the process of evaluating existing credit includes:

  * Prior coursework with a minimum grade of B- or better from institutionally accredited institutions will first be evaluated against UMass Global’s credit-hour-based courses.
  * Once prior credit has been determined to be equivalent to UMass Global’s credit hour-based program, the university will then determine whether you will receive transfer credit for any of the competencies in the MyPath program.
  * Prior transfer credits must be applicable to the MyPath program and count toward its graduation requirements. 

#### [Button: UMass Global MyPath: Will I get credit in the program for my work or “life” experience? ]

UMass Global MyPath programs are specifically designed to allow you to leverage existing skills and knowledge as you progress through your degree. Here's how it works:

  * Many competencies start with an assessment to set a knowledge baseline. The program then adapts itself according to your specific skills. You can spend more time concentrating on the areas where you need more growth and less time on topics you know well, allowing you to complete the program at a potentially quicker pace.
  * Although prior life experience cannot directly satisfy academic credit and official degree requirements, the skills that you have learned in the real world can definitely help you potentially pace through the program faster.

Welcome to the MyPath Program!
 
Thank you for completing the New Student Orientation video!  
You were assigned an Academic Coach today, and your assigned Coach will send you an email within 5 business days containing your class list and next steps. 
 
Next Steps:

  * Wait for the coming email containing your class list from your Academic Coach
  * Once received, review your class list and make the following appointments:
    * Academic Coach – After receiving your class list, and if you have further questions about what classes to take and/or transfer credits you can make an optional appointment wiith your academic coach.
    * One Stop Specialist – This appointment is required to review your payment method and answer financial questions about the program. 
 
In that email is an Excel Sheet for your Degree Progress, and you can see the courses for the course and what are able to be selected from the list of electives.  
UMG transfer credit is awarded from eligible Grad Programs/Courses or E7 Military Rank.  (Policy posted in the FB group). This was explained in email #5 which has the Degree Audit link, and an Excel Sheet attached of classes needed.  
The UMass Global website lists where the ceremonies were for 2025.  No new information is shown for 2026.

#### [Button: Do transfer credits expire? ]

For undergraduate students, there is no time limit to transfer credits. However, if you are enrolling in a UMass Global MyPath (CBE) program, there is a minimum grade requirement of B- or better from accredited institutions.

Please check your specific program, as some others do require a minimum grade for acceptance of transfer credits.

For graduate students, all transferable coursework must be within 7 years of the completion date, with a minimum grade of no less than 3.0 or “B.” All graduate programs must be completed within a 7 year period. 

How does the Academic Fresh Start policy affect transfer credits?

  * Under the Academic Fresh Start policy, UMass Global allows undergraduate applicants to exclude all college or military coursework completed 10 or more years prior to the intended start term from admission consideration, if they believe it is not reflective of their current ability to be successful. However, this means no grades or credits from that period will transfer or be counted toward degree requirements. Coursework completed within the last 10 years must still be submitted via official transcripts and meet current transfer and admission standards and cannot be excluded.

#### [Button: How can I find the course list and prerequisite information for my program? ]

You can find complete course listings and prerequisite details for every UMass Global program in the Academic Catalog. The catalog includes up-to-date degree requirements, foundational courses, and detailed course descriptions for undergraduate and graduate programs.

Some program pages on the UMass Global website also highlight key prerequisite or foundational courses, but the Academic Catalog is the most comprehensive and reliable source for reviewing your full program plan.

### Retaking a COMM Course

**Do you need to retake a COMM course?** (maybe you dropped it in a previous semester, or were unsuccessful in passing it in your last attempt or if you are receiving an error when you are trying to add a required COMM) Please reach out to: **liberal.arts@georgiancollege.ca** for information on how to do that based on the current Academic Policies and Guidelines.

### Ontario Distance Education (ODE) Courses

(ODE) in the course title - refers to Ontario Distance Education (Ontario Learn) courses. If you are registered in an Ontario Learn COMM course and require assistance with log in details/start up, etc. - please reach out to: **ol@georgiancollege.ca**

ODE (Ontario Learn) Courses **DO** come with an extra fee.

**These courses are NOT through Blackboard (even though they may appear as a course in Blackboard/Banner), once registered you will receive an email with detailed instructions on how to access the course.**

*Grades may be delayed (if you are in a program that requires grades for Board exams, please check with the Reg. Office if timing of this course is acceptable to meet those deadlines).

### Course Selection, Previous Courses and Transfer Credits

Please refer to MyPath, or seek advice from your Program Coordinator/Communications Coordinator if you have taken courses previously at Georgian (or Ontario Learn) to ensure you are not taking the same COMM course again (Course codes may be different, but be equivalent) **reach out early - before the end of the Add/Drop period as this could affect your ability to graduate.**

If you have courses from another College of University, and are interested in having them evaluated for credit transfer, it is best to do this early (before the semester starts), and submit course outlines along with the credit transfer request to the Credit Transfer Centre. Please visit Credit Transfer online for more information on this process.

### Competency-based, at your pace

This modality, known as UMass Global MyPath, is built for independent learners who thrive while working solo, on their schedule. You set your own pace with no weekly assignment deadlines or fixed time in class requirement. 

  * Flat-rate tuition: Pay a set fee for each six-month term, completing as much as you are able in that span.
  * Personalized progress: Advance by demonstrating mastery, moving faster through what you already know and spending more time on new or challenging concepts.
  * Support when you need it: Enjoy your independence knowing you’re backed by UMass Global support staff who are ready to assist when needed.
